profile.headline: Microsoft Azure HPC/AI Engineering
profile.summary:
Lead Senior Software Engineer with experience architecting and delivering large-scale, distributed systems for global user bases. Proven ability to design resilient, cloud-native architectures, build real-time telemetry and data pipelines, and modernize security at enterprise scale. Lead cross-functional teams and partner with product, data, and security stakeholders to drive measurable business outcomes. Passionate mentor and culture builder, with a strong track record of onboarding, knowledge sharing, and modernizing legacy ecosystems to enable customer success and operational excellence.  US citizen, authorized to work in the United States, and eligible to apply for security clearance.

Specialties:
Agentic AI coding, full-stack development, distributed systems, cloud-native architecture, real-time telemetry, data pipelines, security modernization, team leadership, mentoring, legacy modernization.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Azure HPC/AI Specialized.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Software Development · Software Systems Engineering

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Microsoft Admin Center (admin.microsoft.com)
• Owned recommendation services in M365 Admin Portal to interface with IDEAS campaigns.  Led partner onboarding to scale adoption and deliver on Copilot initiatives.
• Extended Admin Copilot agent for global self-service diagnostics, improving support coverage for millions of administrators.
• Enhanced security protocols and ensured robust protection for user data by leveraging deep expertise in substrate authentication as part of Microsoft’s Secure Future Initiative.
• Tested pre-launch features for GitHub Copilot Chat in VS Code and Visual Studio.  Evangelized capabilities to other teams and participated in feedback sessions with feature crews.
• Partnered with data scientists to build scalable telemetry pipelines analyzing 30K+ support cases, identifying diagnostic gaps to create new diagnostics for admins.
• Built CSaaS telemetry pipeline enabling real-time adoption insights, improving decision-making.
• Engineered backend APIs to unify Office Product licensing (i.e. 5x5 product keys) across multiple business scenarios, increasing system consistency and decreasing fraud.
• Delivered Visual Mail Flow diagnostic UI using ReactFlow, reducing troubleshooting time and enhancing diagnostic capabilities.
• Participated in leading technical interviews for prospective new hires.  Evaluated their technical 
strengths and team fitness. 
• Actively mentored new hires, led onboarding sessions, and participated in career jams and 
leadership training including manager shadowing.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
Internal Customer Support (assist.microsoft.com)
• Led backend security efforts (Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) mapping, 1P auth transitions, 
legacy secret removal) supporting Microsoft’s Secure Future Initiative. 
• Automated provisioning of Privileged Access Management (PAM), streamlining migrations for 
thousands of users, and reducing manual onboarding overhead. 
• Fully decommissioned multiple legacy services (SQL to Cosmos DB migration), eliminating 
compliance debt and cutting Azure costs.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Ad Sales Marketplace Application 
•	Designed, developed, and delivered an updated ordering system from a windows client to a JavaScript front end using React.js and designed a REST API backend using C# and MS SQL database.
•	Used agile methodologies like a daily SCRUM, a pre-sprint domain walkthrough, a post-sprint retrospective, and occasional code reviews.
•	Extensive experience with EPPlus to build custom excel files for customers.
•	Implemented queues using RabbitMQ to facilitate inter-system communication and order flow.
•	Experienced with using tools like postman and fiddler to assist with debugging and prod support.
•	Also used Redux.js, HTML, git, and experience with a variety of JavaScript components like ag-grid, Semantic UI, Moment.js, axios, bootstrap, express, lodash, idb-keyval, downloadjs, toastify, and jspdf.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Nielsen Ratings Application
•	Helped develop a new Angular.js app with a Node.js backend using mongo DB to manage Nielsen ratings and demographics for all networks.
•	Automated the manual titles matching process using a variety of string comparison techniques and ran statistical analysis to implement a solution with less than 1% false positive errors.

positions.title: Configuration Management Consultant
positions.description:
DevOps Code Migration Application
•	Developed an Angular.js website to facilitate the promotion and approval process of applications (governed by Sarbanes-Oxley regulations) through the development lifecycle.
•	Enabled CI/CD in dev environments.  Assisted with refreshes of code or data from production to a downstream environment.
•	Automated deployment of multiple interconnected systems and several environments for Dev, QA, UAT, and Prod.
•	Also used C#, PowerShell, MS SQL Server, TFS integration.

positions.title: Expert Software Developer
positions.description:
Emmy-Award winning Ad-Sales Traffic Application
•	WinForms application that creates a daily playlist for all broadcast networks.
•	Key contributor on the development of a business-critical ecosystem responsible for generating $5 billion in ad sales revenue annually.
•	This project received critical acclaim from peers in the industry and won an Engineering Emmy Award.
•	Still in use today and is being enhanced to accommodate international networks.
•	Used C#, MS SQL Server, WCF, and 3rd party libraries like DevExpress for client-side controls.
